methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Octavia operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at an undisclosed stage. The comparable universe consists of one public peer (ticker 277810.KQ) and eight private robotics firms, including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer set presents a material constraint: no sufficient narrow cohort of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier companies exists within the sector to support conventional peer-median valuation.

The Peer-Median method is not applicable. While ten same-sector robotics comparables exist, filtering for stage alignment and valuation tier yielded fewer than three datapoints in any subset. A cross-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of robotics business models, capital efficiency profiles, and revenue structures. This limitation prevents reliable triangulation via the primary method.

Given the data constraints, traditional quantitative valuation approaches cannot be defensibly applied to Octavia. Any valuation conclusion would rest on (1) qualitative assessment of founder credentials and market timing, (2) precedent-based reasoning from the named private peers if their financials were available, or (3) bottom-up revenue or unit-economics modeling—none of which are supported by the provided dataset. Valuation work on Octavia requires either narrower stage/tier-specific peer data, disclosure of the company's revenue or growth metrics, or application of alternative methods (venture capital method, sum-of-parts). The current information set is insufficient for a defensible range.
